title: Reset a forgotten password
text: Use password recovery when you cannot sign in. Click Forgot Password, verify your email, then create a new password. This does not unlock accounts blocked for security review.
keywords: password reset forgot recovery login sign in account

title: Unlock an account after failed login attempts
text: If your account is locked after too many failed sign-in attempts, wait 15 minutes or contact support to unlock it. Password recovery alone may not remove a security lock.
keywords: locked account failed attempts unlock security

title: Change the phone used for two-factor authentication
text: When you change phones, update two-factor authentication from Security Settings before wiping the old device. If you no longer have the old device, use backup codes or request identity verification.
keywords: 2FA MFA two factor authentication phone backup codes

title: Request a refund for a cancelled subscription
text: Refunds are available for cancelled subscriptions within 14 days of purchase if usage is below the fair-use threshold. Refunds are returned to the original payment method.
keywords: refund cancelled subscription money back billing

title: Update payment method after card failure
text: If a card payment fails, add a new payment method under Billing Settings. The system retries the invoice automatically after the new card is saved.
keywords: payment card failed billing invoice retry

title: Understand invoice tax details
text: Invoices show tax identification number, billing address, taxable amount, and local tax. Update billing details before the invoice is generated to reflect the correct legal entity.
keywords: invoice tax GST VAT billing address legal entity

title: Track an order that has not arrived
text: Use the shipment tracking link in your order confirmation email. If tracking has not updated for 48 hours, contact logistics support with your order ID.
keywords: track order shipment delivery logistics order id

title: Change delivery address before dispatch
text: Delivery address changes are possible only before warehouse dispatch. After dispatch, the courier must handle rerouting and may charge an additional fee.
keywords: delivery address change dispatch courier

title: Resolve error E1042 during data upload
text: Error E1042 means the uploaded CSV file contains more columns than the import schema allows. Remove extra columns or update the schema mapping before retrying.
keywords: E1042 CSV upload schema columns import error

title: Resolve error E2201 for expired API tokens
text: Error E2201 occurs when an API token has expired or was revoked. Generate a new token in Developer Settings and rotate it in your application secrets.
keywords: E2201 API token expired revoked developer settings

title: Export analytics reports
text: Analytics reports can be exported as CSV or PDF from the Reports page. Large exports are emailed when processing finishes.
keywords: analytics report export CSV PDF

title: Create a dashboard filter
text: Dashboard filters narrow charts by date range, region, plan type, or user segment. Filters can be saved as default views for each dashboard.
keywords: dashboard filters date region segment charts

title: Data retention and account deletion
text: Account deletion removes personal profile data after a 30-day recovery window. Audit logs and invoices may be retained longer for legal and compliance reasons.
keywords: privacy data retention delete account compliance audit logs

title: Download a copy of your personal data
text: You can request a personal data export from Privacy Settings. The export includes profile fields, activity records, and consent history.
keywords: privacy data export download personal data

title: Invite teammates to a workspace
text: Workspace admins can invite teammates by email. Invited users receive a link and must accept before they can access shared projects.
keywords: workspace invite teammates users email access

title: Transfer workspace ownership
text: Only the current owner can transfer workspace ownership. The new owner must already be an admin and must confirm the transfer by email.
keywords: workspace ownership transfer admin owner email

title: Set role-based permissions
text: Role-based permissions control who can view, edit, export, or delete resources. Use least-privilege access for finance, legal, and customer data.
keywords: role based access permissions RBAC least privilege

title: Cancel a trial before billing starts
text: Trials can be cancelled from Billing Settings before the trial end date. Cancelling a trial prevents the first invoice from being generated.
keywords: cancel trial billing invoice subscription

title: Troubleshoot slow dashboard loading
text: Slow dashboards are often caused by wide date ranges or too many high-cardinality filters. Reduce the date range or remove expensive segment filters.
keywords: slow dashboard loading performance filters date range

title: Use webhooks for external notifications
text: Webhooks send event notifications to an external URL when important actions occur, such as payment success, order dispatch, or account deletion.
keywords: webhook notifications external URL events

title: Rotate API keys safely
text: Create a new API key, deploy it to your application, verify traffic, and then revoke the old key. Never expose API keys in client-side code or public repositories.
keywords: API key rotation secrets revoke deploy

title: Understand the fair-use threshold
text: The fair-use threshold limits excessive automation, bulk exports, and unusually high API calls on shared plans. Enterprise plans can request higher thresholds.
keywords: fair use threshold automation bulk exports API calls

title: Change notification preferences
text: Notification preferences control product updates, billing alerts, workspace invitations, and security messages. Security messages cannot be disabled.
keywords: notifications preferences billing alerts security messages

title: Recover a deleted project
text: Deleted projects remain recoverable for seven days. Workspace admins can restore them from the Trash page during the recovery period.
keywords: recover deleted project restore trash workspace

title: Why an export may omit restricted fields
text: Some exports omit restricted fields when the requester lacks permission or when a compliance policy blocks the data from leaving the workspace.
keywords: export restricted fields permissions compliance policy

title: Set up single sign-on with SAML
text: Single sign-on with SAML lets employees authenticate through an identity provider. Configure entity ID, ACS URL, and certificate details in Security Settings.
keywords: SSO SAML identity provider ACS URL certificate
